Both layers agree Mel wins all 7 stages; kits support the pattern (both his Q and R are reflectable projectiles, he has no dash). The 43.79% WR against a 7/7 chart is flagged by the packet — recorded in notes, not adjudicable from the kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six content fields (whys[4], whys[6], spikes[1], spikes[3], mid, late, wants.you[2] — two flagged by suspectNames) credit Golden Eclipse (R) with the reflect. Mel's reflect is Rebuttal (W); her R executes. Both Bouncing Bomb and Mega Inferno Bomb carry the projectile flag, so the reflect claims themselves are sound once reassigned to W.
audit.why: Kit: mel W reflects projectiles; ziggs Q and R flagged projectile; W Satchel and E mines are not.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback escape — he is catchable only while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Rebuttal like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Satchel Charge: 20s at rank 1, 12s max — his only escape; he is catchable that whole window. - Bouncing Bomb cycles every 6-4s: reflect or sidestep it. - Guard W Rebuttal (38s early) for his rotation. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
